# Fixer

Fixer is a currency data API providing real-time and historical exchange rates for 170 world currencies.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fixer/.

## Actions

- **Get Historical Rates** (read-only): Get historical exchange rate data for a specific date.
- **Get Latest Exchange Rates** (read-only): Get real-time exchange rate data for all available or specified currencies.
- **Get Supported Symbols** (read-only): Retrieve all supported currency symbols and their full names.
